title: Organization access token (polar_oat_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: POLAR_OAT_ vs the lower-case polar_oat_. Twin of "Organization access token (polar_oat_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review.
